title: Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.34180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). T

translated_title: 书写重要内容：解耦循环记忆中的词元选择与槽位分配
translated_abstract: 长序列模型必须保留较早的信息。全注意力机制保留所有历史词元但成本高昂，而循环记忆模型则将历史压缩至固定槽位中以实现线性时间处理。有限的容量使得写入操作至关重要：干扰信息会影响有用内容的存储，而被跳过的证据则无法再被召回。现有的多槽位记忆模型将每个词元写入相同数量的槽位，从而将“是否存储”与“更新多少槽位”这两个决策混为一谈。我们提出因子化写入路由，首先决定保留或跳过每个词元，然后再选择固定或词元自适应的槽位数量，而查询时仍然读取所有槽位。在两个于长上下文之后查询事实的合成任务上进行十个随机种子的实验中，我们观察到一种依赖于信息密度的反转现象：在每次写入四个槽位的情况下，长上下文准确率在信息密集的Feature Recall任务上偏向始终写入（0.472 vs 0.337），而在稀疏事实的Passkey任务上偏向学习到的选择性写入（0.222 vs 0.048）。
tldr: 该论文提出因子化写入路由，将循环记忆中“是否存储某个词元”与“写入多少槽位”两个决策解耦，并揭示最优写入策略取决于信息密度：密集信息任务适合始终写入，稀疏事实任务适合学习到的选择性写入。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which disentangles whether to store a token from how many memory slots to update in recurrent memory, revealing a density-dependent reversal where dense tasks favor always writing while sparse-fact tasks favor learned selective writing.
